I've seen some DGX Spark users talking about GPU throttling . You can also use https://t.co/pHU1lCMTBT to throttle your DGX Spark GPU and persist your configuration for your setup:

sparkrun setup throttle-gpu-clock

Examples:

    sparkrun setup throttle-gpu-clock --cluster
